title: Event
description: All events that can appear in the client event stream.

oneOf.description: A run has started.

schedule_id.description: The schedule that started this run (scheduled runs only; additive).

oneOf.description: A run has completed (successfully or not).

error.description: `None` on success, an error message on failure.

oneOf.description: A partial text chunk from the assistant.

text.description: Incremental text to append to the current assistant message.

oneOf.description: The agent has requested a tool call; waiting for approval or execution.
A human-approval gate is waiting for the user to respond.

details.description: Structured facts the tool supplies for the approval card (for example a schedule's prompt and next firing times), when it has any.

summary.description: A human-readable summary of what will happen.

oneOf.description:
A pending tool call was allowed to run: the owner approved its card, or an automatic rule did the owner's part (see [`GrantedBy`]).

The three provenance fields are additive. An event recorded before they existed has none of them and always meant an answered card, but it does not say so: readers show it as an approval of unknown provenance.

approved_by.description: The owner who answered the card; for an automatic grant, the user the run belongs to (nobody answered).

level.description: The bot's permission level when the call was decided.

rule_id.description: The remembered rule that covered the call, as `<scope>:<name>` with scope `chat`, `always`, `category` or `task` and `name` a tool or category name. Never a path, address, command or other text of the call.

oneOf.description: The user denied a pending tool call.
A tool call has completed; output is available.

duration_ms.description: Time the tool itself ran, in milliseconds (excludes approval waits).

error.description: `None` on success, an error message on failure.

output_preview.description: Truncated (at most 2 KB), redacted start of the tool's output.

oneOf.description: The model replaced its todo list (plan tool); carries the full new list.
The model asked the user a question (`ask_user`); the run waits until the question is answered.

The model asked the owner for a credential (`secret_request`); the run waits until the owner submits it on the local desktop or cancels. The event carries what the card shows and NEVER a value: the owner's app posts the value straight to the daemon (`POST /v1/secret-requests/{call_id}`).

call_id.description: Id to submit or cancel with.

expires_in_secs.description: Seconds until the request expires on its own.

name.description: The `fill/` entry name the value will be stored under (without the prefix).

origin.description: The exact browser origin the owner authorizes. Missing in old journal events.

parked.description: A mission asked: no run waits for the answer. The item that needs it is parked as blocked and the session moved on; the owner's answer releases that item. The card stays open after the tool call has returned.

purpose.description: Why the bot asks. Plain text written by the model: untrusted, never markup.

replaces_existing.description: An entry with this name already exists and the bot asked to replace it.

untrusted_content.description: The run has already read untrusted content (a page, a mail, a download): the card must warn that the request may have been planted there.

oneOf.description: The bot needs the owner for a step it must not do itself (`browser_handover`); the run waits until the owner answers on the local desktop or the request expires. The event carries what the card shows and NEVER a code: the owner's app posts it straight to the daemon (`POST /v1/handovers/{call_id}/code`).

expires_in_secs.description: Seconds until the request expires on its own.

site.description: Origin the browser reports for the page (`https://example.com:443`), read by the daemon, never taken from page text.

untrusted_content.description: The run has already read untrusted content (a page): the card warns that a fake prompt on a page can ask for a code.

oneOf.description: The loop switched to a fallback model after the previous one kept failing.

reason.description: The error that caused the switch.

oneOf.description: The K0-K3 ladder decided how a turn starts (ADR-0005), before the main model (K4) runs.  Emitted once per top-level turn of a bot whose router is enabled.

latency_ms.description: Wall time of the whole decision.

level.description: Level that decided: `K0` (rules / commands), `K1` (intent cache), `K2` (BM25 + embeddings), `K3` (classifier) or `K4` (nothing cheaper applied).

reason.description: Why (for the "why did it do that" panel).

tier.description: Optional first-turn model tier (`light` or `standard`). Absent when disabled.

oneOf.description: A recorded workflow step is about to run (deterministic replay, no model).

run_id.description: Run that started the replay, if it was started from a run.

oneOf.description: A workflow step finished successfully.

resolved_via.description: Locator strategy that found the target, when the step had one.

oneOf.description: A workflow step could not run (drift, ambiguity, failure or denial); the replay stopped and control goes back to the agent.

A desktop action is about to run: the daemon asks the desktop app (if one is connected) to show the on-screen overlay first.  The app answers with `POST /v1/control/{request_id}`; without an answer the daemon decides on its own after a timeout.

label.description: Short description of the target, e.g. `Save button`.

rect.description: Target of the action (global physical screen pixels), when known.

oneOf.description: The agent spawned a subagent (a child run of the same bot).  Emitted on the parent run's stream; the child's own events carry `parent_run_id` in their envelope.

call_id.description: The parent's `spawn_subagent` tool call that created the child.

helper.description: Set when the child is ANOTHER bot asked through `ask_bot`: the hand-off card shows who asked whom. Daemon-supplied, never model text.

task.description: What the child was asked to do.

oneOf.description: A subagent run ended.

call_id.description: The parent's `spawn_subagent` tool call that created the child.

summary.description: The child's final text (at most 2 KB here; the parent's tool result carries up to 8 KB) or the failure message.

oneOf.description: The user restored a file checkpoint of this run.

checkpoint_id.description: Restored checkpoint id, or `"all"` when undoing the whole run.

partial.description: Restore attempt failed; inspect warnings and safety snapshots.

safety_checkpoint_id.description: Safety snapshot created of the overwritten state before restoring.

oneOf.description: A non-fatal error occurred during the run.

AutonomyLevel.description: The permission level the bot was on when the call was decided.

ControlRect.description: A rectangle in global physical screen pixels.

GrantedBy.description: What let a tool call run: who or which rule answered the question that would otherwise have been a card. A closed set of daemon facts; nothing a page, a mail or a tool result says can reach it.

oneOf.description: The owner answered an approval card for this very call.
The Full level let the call through without a card, in a run the owner started.
The Full level let the call through in a run started by a schedule, rule, webhook or mail the owner set up.
The Full level let the call through in an unattended session of the owner's mission.
The Balanced level's lane let the call through.
An owner-created standing grant covered exactly this call.
A choice the owner made earlier on a card ("this chat", "always", "for this task") covered the call; `rule_id` names it.
The owner's own per-site or per-app allow rule covered the call.

HandoverKind.description: What the owner is asked to do on a [`HandoverRequested`] card.

oneOf.description: The page shows a CAPTCHA the bot could not (or should not) solve: the owner takes control of the browser, solves it and presses "Done".
The page wants a one-time code (2FA). The owner types it into the card; the daemon types it into the page. It is never stored and never reaches the model, the journal or the logs.

SecretFields.description: What a [`SecretRequested`] card asks the owner to type.

oneOf.description: One secret value (an API key, a token, a password on its own).
A username and a password, stored as `<name>/username` and `<name>/password`.

SubagentHelper.description: The two bots of an `ask_bot` hand-off, for the chat card.

bot_id.description: The bot that was asked (the child run executes as this bot).

bot_name.description: Display name of the bot that was asked.

caller_name.description: Display name of the bot that asked.

TodoItem.description: One entry of the model-maintained todo list.
